## Class Problems.

Prepare a 1-page report that focuses on two numeric variables from the Mini Class Dataset. 

Make sure your report includes the following. You do not need to include R Code; think about what a viewer of this document would want (or need) to see. We'll take a look at some examples in class.

1.  A description of the dataset - who was studied and how many people were studied?
2.  Graphs of your variables.
3.  Descriptive statistics for these variables. Nice if you can orgnaize them into a table! Describe any data cleaning that you did (e.g., outlier removal.)
4.  A summary of what you learn about each of these variables, and additional questions that you have.
